content.title: Stellantis looks to North America for its rebound as vehicle shipments jump 35% in Q3
content.summary: The automaker is banking on the new Jeep Cherokee to further boost its U.S. sales, the company’s CEO said on a Thursday earnings call.

thumbnail.caption: The 2026 Jeep Cherokee. Production has been on hiatus since Q1, 2023, but the new model is expected to arrive at U.S. dealers later this year.

content.title: Stellantis, Volkswagen Stocks Rally After China Says It Will Ease Chip Curbs
content.summary: Shares in European automakers rose Monday on optimism that a semiconductor supply shortage will soon be resolved. China said over the weekend that it will loosen export restrictions on auto chips made by Nexperia.
